title: Finite projective modules become free after localization at a prime.
statement: For a commutative ring R, finite projective R-modules X and Y, and a prime ideal 𝔭, the scalar extensions of X and Y to Localization.AtPrime 𝔭 are free modules over that localization.

proof.text: Register the given finiteness and projectivity hypotheses as local instances. For each scalar extension, unfold ModuleCat.extendScalars to its tensor-product carrier and use the algebra structure (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime 𝔭)).toAlgebra, whose scalar action agrees with Module.compHom. Mathlib supplies finiteness of the base-changed module, Module.Flat.of_projective, and Module.Flat.baseChange. The prime localization is a local ring. Apply Module.free_of_flat_of_isLocalRing (Stacks Tag 00NZ) separately to X and Y, then combine the results by And.intro.

proof_origin.note: Complete Lean proof from Mathlib finiteness/flatness base-change instances and finite-flat freeness over a local ring; no project sorry dependencies.
